column2: A choice per opponent from the union of their hand and the permanents they control (Choose over a union of zones, asked of each opponent, then Exile of the chosen card or permanent), and a static "has all loyalty abilities of all other planeswalkers on the battlefield" (an ability grant reading other permanents' Loyalty abilities, with their loyalty costs paid from Nicol Bolas)

A decision owner override for DeclareAttackers and DeclareBlockers for one turn (the caster chooses which creatures attack and which block and how, CR 508.1a/509.1a, with the other players' requirements still checked); `Rule::R6400ChoosesBlocks` covers blocks only

No card file or fixture yet; then a per-combat record of the attackers a requirement (goad, "attacks each combat if able") bound at their declaration, read by an intervening "if that creature had to attack this combat"

Choose per player by that player (each player chooses a creature with power 2 or less they control), and a turn fact "attacked you or a planeswalker you control this turn" read by a cast prohibition on the back face

ReplaceWhen over a whole batch: the life total would be reduced to 0 or less by all simultaneous damage and life loss (CR 614.1, 119.3), replaced by [Transform This, SetLife 3]; the replacement pass sees one event at a time
A granted activated ability that only the granter's controller may activate (Activators on a granted ability), with a damage redirect shield to the granted creature

A contest loop: each player exiles their top card, the players tied for the greatest mana value repeat among themselves until one alone has it, and that player takes an extra turn (RepeatWhile over a shrinking player set bound per pass)
A face-down exiled pile kept in order on its source (an ordered memory slot shuffled as a pile), filled by a search for seven cards, with a draw replacement taking its top card

A control change lasting while an Aura stays attached to the permanent (Duration::WhileAttached read in the control layer), and a trigger on an Aura becoming attached comparing the host's mana value with the Aura's
A control change to an opponent until end of combat with the creature then attacking a player or planeswalker that opponent attacks (JoinAttack for another player's attack after the control change)

A ReplaceBy that keeps an opponent's entering land (a land play included) and has that player sacrifice a land after it, with the "controls at least as many lands as you" condition read before the land enters
An additional cost "sacrifice an artifact or creature with mana value X" with X announced with the cost (XCost::Parts), read by the divided damage amount
A Condition on a target spell "if it would destroy a land you control" (reading the effects the target spell would have) for a granted activated counter
A static prevention filter relating source and recipient: damage a creature would deal to another creature that shares a color with it (DamageShield predicate over both)
A replacement applied by an opponent (CR 614.1, 616): that opponent may have each 1 damage remove an echo counter instead of making you lose life
A variable mana payment in the enchanted player's upkeep ("may pay any amount of {X}"), then prevention of that much of the damage the trigger deals

A counter-scaled prevention of damage from sources of the color chosen as the Aura enters ("prevent X of that damage, where X is the number of sleight counters"), with the chosen color remembered on the Aura
XCost over an opponent the caster chooses as X is fixed ("X is the number of artifact and/or creature cards in an opponent's graveyard as you cast this spell", CR 601.2b)
A permanent card revealed in its owner's hand with "can't play it" until that player's next turn, after a dies replacement returning it to hand
A CR 609.7 hook for the color of damage sources: black and red permanents and spells deal damage as colorless sources (a damage-source characteristic override read by protection and prevention)

A prevention filter "damage a source would deal because of a spell or ability that targets that creature" (the shield reads whether the spell or ability causing the damage targets the protected creature)
